lead_raw_text:
This hexagonal P-62m (No. 143) phase of composition Mg6Fe3N6 (reduced formula Mg2FeN2) has 15 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe centers with four N neighbors and Mg centers with five N neighbors, while N centers have six neighbors (three Fe and three Mg). The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 15 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Mg 5-vertex polyhedra, and edge- and face-sharing between N 6-vertex polyhedra.
